standards.title: ISO 10642:2026
standards.description: Hexagon socket countersunk head screws with reduced loadability.

notes.title: Standard scope
notes.text: The standard covers steel and stainless steel screws with metric coarse threads from M2 to M20.

notes.title: Reduced loadability
notes.text: The countersunk head and socket geometry reduce loadability. Check the specified property class and the application requirements.

notes.title: DIN 7991 reference
notes.text: DIN 7991 is a withdrawn reference. Verify dimensions and application suitability before substituting ISO 10642.

customManufacturing.headline: Custom Manufacturing and Bulk Supply for Factories
customManufacturing.intro: From custom screws and bolts to SEMS assemblies, we support OEM production and factory purchasing based on your drawings and requirements.

cards.title: Made to Your Drawing
cards.text: Specify head shape, drive, thread, material and finish. We review the drawing and manufacturing requirements before quotation.

cards.title: Factory Bulk Orders
cards.text: For OEM assembly lines and repeat production orders. Share batch quantity, annual demand, inspection requirements and delivery schedule.

cards.title: Custom SEMS Assemblies
cards.text: Screw and captive-washer assemblies configured to your application: head and drive, flat or spring washers, material and finish. Confirm washer dimensions and assembly details in your drawing.
